objective: Test whether a causal SMC/ICT supply-demand and liquidity model can reproduce the useful behavior pattern seen in the AFIQ reference cases without copying AFIQ forecast prices into runtime decisions.

state_machine.EARLY_TAKE_RISK: High-quality effective HTF zone is reached, bounded liquidity context exists, structural invalidation is intact, and first-target RR is at least 1.50. Reclaim/MSS is not mandatory for this initial research state.
state_machine.CONFIRMED: A causal reclaim/acceptance level is subsequently confirmed; this upgrades confidence rather than creating the first entry from scratch.
state_machine.BLOCKED_EVENT: High-impact event blackout overrides anticipatory entry.
state_machine.INVALIDATED: Structural invalidation is accepted beyond, defined as explicit acceptance or at least two closes beyond the structural boundary; a wick alone is insufficient.
state_machine.WATCH_ZONE: Zone is reached but quality or RR is below the frozen threshold.
state_machine.PREPARE: Price is near the selected effective zone.
state_machine.WAIT: Selected effective zone is not reached.

regression_cases: 2026-10-05 style LONG: effective H4 demand permits EARLY_TAKE_RISK before reclaim when score/RR pass
Post-entry reclaim upgrades state to CONFIRMED
Liquidity wick beyond structural floor does not invalidate without acceptance
Two closes beyond structural floor invalidate
High-impact event blackout blocks anticipatory entry
Main effective zone outranks minor reaction when quality is materially stronger
Price-translation invariance prevents memorized AFIQ level logic
